# Tic Tac Tooth Pediatric Dentistry

> A kid-friendly pediatric dental practice in Naperville, IL providing comprehensive children's dental care from preventive treatments to specialized pediatric dentistry services.

Tic Tac Tooth Pediatric Dentistry is a specialized practice led by board-certified pediatric dentists including Dr. Asim Awan, Dr. Jiana Panos, Dr. Sarah Specht, and Dr. Ji-Hoon Min. The practice focuses on creating a welcoming environment for children while delivering evidence-based dental care aligned with American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry standards.

## Key Topics

- Pediatric dentistry
